native_review.scope: Input selection review for the explicitly pinned private Windows AMD64 CPython/Tcl/Tk/OpenSSL/libffi/zlib graph. Issued runtime receipt requires all native build/probe gates to pass; selection approval is not a claim of executed Windows validation or general security certification.
notes: zlib 1.3.2 is replaced by official 1.4 for both CPython and Tcl after upstream Nov4 security fixes. Matching Tcl headers/import library/DLL are staged together and actual zlib versions are asserted.

Official CPython binary dependency tags currently end at libffi 3.4.4. Upstream publishes no security advisories. The 3.4.8 small-argument overread fix concerns ffi64.c after d21881f (2024-09-15), introduced after 3.4.4, separate from MSVC ffiw64.c. Retain exact CPython-compatible 3.4.4 AMD64 bundle rather than changing ABI for unrelated targets. Later hardening/correctness changes do not establish a known exploitable flaw in this selection.

Expat 2.9.0 is explicitly security-upgraded by CPython 3.11.18. Reviewed mpdecimal post-2.5.1 C changes cover formatting/flag/reliability behavior; no published target security finding was identified in this bounded primary-source review.

Unused native bz2/lzma/sqlite modules are omitted. Compiler/SDK/OS and Python package advisory audits are separate; actual TkDND loading, packaged behavior, repeatability and human desktop checks remain mandatory downstream gates.

embedded_native.expat: 2.9.0 bundled in CPython3.11.18; security update documented by CPython release
